purpose: Provenance for the four M6 context packages collected from the 102 collector, 113 inference host, and Atlas 33 training node.

normalized_source_snapshot.note: All 98 deduplicated source/configuration files from the four input bundles are committed individually in the repository. The generated ZIP is only a convenience transfer artifact; the repository snapshot is the canonical archived copy.

exclusions: VPN/Linux passwords, SSH keys, tokens, .env files
virtual environments, package caches, Python bytecode
runtime logs, PID snapshots, temporary files, old backups
deduplication: Atlas 33 core and supplement share 8 identical source paths; duplicates are stored once in the curated snapshot.
113 discovered/entrypoint copies duplicate project source files; only one copy of each unique project source is stored.
note: The manifest records source provenance. It does not claim that every upstream reference file has been merged into the canonical overlays or that the collected source is a complete standalone XR-1 checkout.

canonical_overlay_sync.note: Selected current runtime/training files are also synchronized into these working directories; the complete source capture remains under code/snapshots.
